prompt: What is the estimated time until collision if my car is traveling at a velocity of 20 m/s, accelerating at 2 m/s^2, and the vehicle ahead is moving at 15 m/s with an acceleration of 1 m/s^2, given that the initial distance between us is 50 meters?

tools.name: get_headway
tools.description: Calculates the headway, which is the distance from the front of the ego vehicle to the closest leading object, using curvilinear coordinates. This function requires the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes from perception data.

ego_info.description: Information about the ego vehicle, including its position and orientation.

position.description: Curvilinear coordinates of the ego vehicle, consisting of lateral and longitudinal positions.

lateral.description: Lateral position of the ego vehicle in meters.

longitudinal.description: Longitudinal position of the ego vehicle in meters.

orientation.description: Orientation of the ego vehicle in degrees.

lane_id.description: Unique identifier for the detected lane.

bounding_boxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing detected objects. Each bounding box should include dimensions and the object's position relative to the ego vehicle.

tools.name: get_time_headway
tools.description: Calculates the time headway (THW), which is the time it will take for the ego vehicle to reach the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates. Inputs include the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes of the perceived objects.

ego_info.description: Contains the ego vehicle's current position and velocity.

position.description: The vehicle's current position as a tuple of x, y, and z coordinates (meters).

velocity.description: The vehicle's current velocity in meters per second (m/s).

lane_info.description: Information about the detected lane, including its curvature and width.

curvature.description: The curvature of the lane at the ego vehicle's position (1/meters).

width.description: The width of the lane in meters (m).

bboxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing perceived objects. Each bounding box is described by its position and size.

velocities.description: List of velocities of the detected objects in meters per second (m/s).

accelerations.description: List of accelerations of the detected objects in meters per second squared (m/s^2).

tools.name: get_time_to_collision
tools.description: Calculates the time it will take for the ego vehicle to collide with the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates, considering both vehicles' velocities and the leading object's acceleration.

ego_velocity.description: The current velocity of the ego vehicle in meters per second.

ego_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the ego vehicle in meters per second squared.

leading_object_velocity.description: The current velocity of the leading object in meters per second.

leading_object_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the leading object in meters per second squared.

initial_distance.description: The initial distance between the ego vehicle and the leading object in meters.
